But no matter what you do, just follow the 3 big Ds

DISCIPLINE: Don't fuck around with your form. Don't blindingly increase weight. When you are on the Path, you don't lift to impress, you lift for yourself.

DIET: Eat well, eat plenty, eat with purpose. Don't deny your body the building blocks it needs but don't drown it in shit it doesn't need either.

DIVERSITY: Don't be a one trick pony. Expan your horizons. Try new exercises. Don't let your body become accustomed to something, it will stall your progress.

Keep them close to your heart and you will prosper.

TL;DR: Cross-Fit is shit. Mix compound with isolation exercises. Eat. GET SWOLE.
